name: RW03-B4 Approval and SoD controller
description: RW03-B4 (RW03 real-world test). Creates an approval request per matched invoice, chooses the approver by amount and route (the buyer for price variance), never lets requesters approve their own invoice, asks a second approver above the threshold, handles decline and timeout, signs each decision (HMAC) so SAP staging can check it, resumes safely from its checkpoint and notifies QA recipients only.

variables.name: result_file
variables.description: CSV file with one row per record.

variables.name: evidence_file
variables.description: Evidence rows of this agent (one per record).

args.text: What this agent does: Creates an approval request per matched invoice, chooses the approver by amount and route (the buyer for price variance), never lets requesters approve their own invoice, asks a second approver above the threshold, handles decline and timeout, signs each decision (HMAC) so SAP staging can check it, resumes safely from its checkpoint and notifies QA recipients only. It works through 10 approval dossiers (the matched ones) and writes its results to the run's output folder.
